# 洲際彈道企鵝計畫
[![Discord 徽章](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-16181C?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=5865F2)](https://discord.tophatcat.dev)
[![CurseForge 徽章](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-16181C?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&logoColor=FF784D)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/project-icbp)
[![Modrinth 徽章](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-16181C?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=17B85A)](https://modrinth.com/mod/project-icbp)
[![Bluesky 徽章](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bluesky-16181C?style=for-the-badge&logo=bluesky&logoColor=1185FE)](https://bsky.app/profile/tophatcat.dev)
[![Github 徽章](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-16181C?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=BBDDE5)](https://github.com/kiris-mods/project-icbp)
[![網站徽章](https://img.shields.io/badge/tophatcat.dev-16181C?style=for-the-badge&logo=&logoColor=57Z29S)](https://tophatcat.dev/mods/project-icbp)

喔看這隻可愛友善的企鵝……**喔看那隻企鵝正朝我們衝過來！！！**

為 2024 年冬季遊戲創作大賽製作  
這個模組增加了一隻在雪地生態域中漫步的企鵝朋友，模組目前仍在開發中，但一旦完成，你**絕對不會**想在牠們附近待太久——除非你隨身帶著一些生魚來餵牠們，這是你唯一能存活下來的方式！

![展示彈道企鵝的圖片](https://tophatcat.dev/mods/project-icbp/ballistic-penguin.png)
